origin: Original synthetic reference-board.png created for this benchmark
approval_scope: Inspect for art direction and redistribute the original board with this benchmark

observations.grid: A wide opening and a wide introductory region precede two equal prose columns and a wider text panel paired with narrower art.
observations.hierarchy: Two heavy navy lines establish the title scale. Teal supports subheads. The board uses bars, so the type family is unknown.
observations.color: Navy anchors the hierarchy, teal identifies companion subheads, rust provides emphasis, and cream recedes behind figures.
observations.rhythm: Open outer margins and visibly larger gaps between regions than between lines.
observations.image_treatment: One wide dark image carries the opening, followed by a small cream-toned inset with generous internal space.
observations.density: Moderate prose density with compact secondary regions and clear group boundaries.
observations.illustration_style: Flat geometric line work, round route nodes, and a limited palette.
observations.audience: Inferred teaching material for first-time readers. The actual audience comes from the workbook source brief.

checks: Styles carry the observed color roles and relative title and body scale. Georgia is an editorial choice with Cyrillic support.
Word shows a landscape image inside the opening page, then a wide IP lead and native two-column prose.
The client and server passage places the explanatory text before the smaller image and caption.
The workbook uses original images with the board's visual treatment and retains the separate source IDs and exact code.
